purpose: Read-only verification of local test-server source-plugin framework availability
conclusion: The live local server responds to native queries, but the queried native command index has no oxide or countdiag entries. oxide.version and oxide.plugins did not yield correlated replies. A working loaded Oxide source-plugin framework is not established for the current process.
limits: The presence of Oxide files on disk and an offline compilation against them does not prove that the live server loaded them.
The absence of commands and startup-log mentions is evidence against assuming a working Oxide plugin runtime; no process memory or managed assembly loading was inspected.
Deploying ReportingDiagnostics requires a compatible, actually loaded Oxide source-plugin framework and verification of its real load result; this observation performs no installation.
